posts.title: Quick Post - Pokemon Bank Deadline Looming
posts.description: Hello everynyan I have been in a frazzled state as I realize the looming February 25th deadline for getting Pokemon from the GBA/DS era into Pokemon Home is ever approaching. I want to finish Pokemon Sapphire, which means I need to get that battery replaced pronto. I also need to finish Pokemon HeartGold, but particularly with a finished Pokedex, which means I have to beat the game and then some.
